RATCHET IT DOWN AGGRESSIVELY — keep it a hair above the current floor, never leave slack. The slack is what lets a clone slip: glazeDrip.js re-inlined mulberry32 (an ALREADY-paid-off clone) and the gate stayed green only because the threshold sat at 1.8 while the true floor had drifted to ~1.21 — 0.6% of hidden headroom. Set threshold ≈ floor + 0.04 so ANY new ~10-line clone trips it; when you legitimately pay a clone off, drop the threshold to the new floor in the SAME commit. History: 2.82% (wiring) → 2.62% (heightfield→normalMap helper) → 2.21% (value-noise helper) → 2.09% (mulberry32 PRNG → utils/random.js) → 1.93% (ChipPicker shared by the Frosting/Style pickers) → 1.73% (useDragPlacement hook shared by AgeNumber/CreamWriting) → 1.25% (glazeDrip re-import of mulberry32 removed + slack removed). A deliberate, reviewed clone goes between `// jscpd:ignore-start` … `// jscpd:ignore-end` so it doesn't count. SCOPE (widened 2026-07-31): the gate covered ONLY src/designer, so ten other directories could accumulate clones unwatched. Measured before widening: eight of twelve were already at 0.00% — the problem was never 'the rest of the code', it was two directories. src/settings (7.67%, 14 clones — repeated form-field/card markup) and src/chefsdesk (5.25%, 3) are EXCLUDED for now and are the next thing to pay off; everything else is in, and the floor FELL to 1.09% because most of what was added is clean. Note the denominator moved too, so part of that drop is arithmetic rather than virtue. Fold settings/chefsdesk in as they are cleaned, dropping the threshold in the same commit. History: 2.82% → 2.62% → 2.21% → 2.09% → 1.93% → 1.73% → 1.25% → 1.13% (scope widened to all of src except settings/chefsdesk) -> 0.87% (re-ratchet, no clone paid off) -> 0.84% (boundsOf in topperShape.js re-walked bbox's own loop; deferred to bbox, floor back to 0.80). THE FLOOR CAN FALL WITHOUT ANYONE PAYING OFF A CLONE, and the threshold then sits silently loose. 1.13 was correct when set (floor 1.09 + 0.04), but adding CLEAN code grows the denominator and the percentage falls on its own: 61,564 -> 62,178 total lines with duplicated lines unmoved at 517 put the floor at 0.83%, leaving 0.30% (~187 lines) of headroom that a ten-line clone would have walked through. So re-measure and re-ratchet whenever the TREE GROWS, not only when a clone is extracted -- otherwise the gate loosens as a reward for writing clean code, which is precisely backwards. AND KNOW WHAT THIS GATE CANNOT SEE: it detects COPY-PASTE, matching token runs at minTokens 50 / minLines 8. It cannot detect REINVENTION -- a fresh 12-line style helper duplicating the JOB of a 60-line shared component shares no token run with it and is invisible here. Not hypothetical: a hand-rolled chip went in at 85cb0ef while src/shared/Chip.jsx sat unused, and this gate was green throughout. Reuse is enforced by looking before you build (CLAUDE.md rule 1), never by this number. LICENCE TEXT IS EXCLUDED (2026-08-31): vendoring four OFL typefaces means four verbatim copies of the same licence, 267 identical lines that tripped the gate at 1.23%. Shortening or de-duplicating them is not an option -- the OFL requires the notice be redistributed unaltered -- and it is not copy-pasted CODE, which is what this gate is for. Excluded by name rather than by widening the threshold, so the slack does not leak into the source.
